baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذُكِّرَ ... فَأَعْرَضَ ... وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: A reminder makes marked material present again, but bodily turning-away interrupts that recovery and leaves the agent's own prior production outside active memory.

activation_trace.role: Recovery after forgetting supplies the attempted return to awareness.
The evident mark supplies what the reminder places before the addressee.
Turning one's side supplies the active interruption rather than passive absence.
Loss from recollection supplies the resulting break in self-account.
Advancing ahead makes prior action something sent forward into the agent's future.
What the two hands earn fixes responsibility in the agent's own production.

changed_reading.before: The person is reminded, turns away, and forgets past deeds.
changed_reading.after: The reminder attempts to restore visibly marked truth, but an enacted turn severs the person from the future already authored by their own hands.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The inner core is covered and the organ of receptive hearing is weighted, so signal can arrive without becoming inward comprehension.

activation_trace.role: Making something assume a condition supplies the configured state of reception.
The core or pith locates the blockage at the inward center rather than at information supply.
A preserving cover supplies the enclosure interposed over the inward core.
Grasping a matter supplies the cognitive operation that the enclosure blocks.
Attentive acceptance of what is heard supplies the receptive gateway.
Auditory heaviness supplies the obstruction at that gateway.

changed_reading.before: They do not understand because their hearts are covered and their ears are deafened.
changed_reading.after: The verse maps a configured reception failure: audible signs reach an ear made unreceptive and therefore never penetrate to the inward act of grasping.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَإِن تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًا
baseline_models.mechanism: A verbal summons points toward a way, but the emphatic result denies transition into that orientation and extends the non-arrival without an endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies the attempted attraction toward a destination.
Gentle indication of the true road supplies both the offered guidance and the denied uptake.
Direction and intended course turn guidance into a trajectory rather than a datum.
Unbounded duration extends the failed transition beyond a single refusal.

changed_reading.before: Even when called, they will never accept guidance.
changed_reading.after: The call still reaches them, but their response-system cannot convert address into a change of course; the verse diagnoses enduring directional lock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between growth reduced to wind-scattered fragments and good remainder returning as recompense recasts what the hands advance as a temporal investment whose yield may disperse or endure.

activation_trace.role: Dry broken vegetation supplies the image of a once-coherent yield losing durability.
Wind-driven scattering supplies the dispersal of that yield.
Continuance supplies the opposing durable remainder.
A deed's recompense returning to its doer supplies the future return on what was advanced.
Sending action ahead anchors the temporal contrast in the focus clause.
Neglect supplies the broken feedback between present action and later yield.

structural_cues: 18:45-46 moves from a rapidly dispersed yield to a remainder evaluated by return and hope.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersal, durability, return, and action sent ahead; I infer that this contrast frames the focus person's forgotten production. Alternatively, the contrast may only rank worldly goods against good deeds without specifying the psychology of forgetting.

changed_reading.before: They forget the bad things they previously did.
changed_reading.after: They lose the temporal feedback by which present handiwork becomes future yield, forgetting both that actions travel ahead and that only some returns endure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Public exposure, an obligatory record, exhaustive counting, and deeds found present make subjective forgetting powerless to erase what the hands advanced.

activation_trace.role: Presentation for sight supplies the public exposure that reverses the focus turning-away.
A written fixation that obligates supplies an external record resistant to memory loss.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies the record's completeness.
Intentional action supplies the very content preserved by the record.
Presence under observation supplies the return of deeds as an immediate object.
Personal loss of recollection anchors the asymmetry between memory and record.
Hand-earned production identifies the recorded material as self-authored.

structural_cues: 18:47-49 progresses from terrain laid bare, to persons presented, to a record placed, to deeds found present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, fixed inscription, exhaustive count, and present deeds; I infer that these form the objective counterpart to focus-memory failure. Alternatively, the focus forgetting could denote culpable disregard without a claim about ordinary recall.

changed_reading.before: Forgetting hides prior deeds from the offender.
changed_reading.after: Forgetting is a private deletion attempt inside a scene of objective conservation: what leaves self-memory remains written, countable, and presentable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Choosing an enemy as protective ally redirects allegiance; the later unanswered call to claimed partners mirrors the focus person's failure to answer a call toward guidance, while the intervening barrier makes the failed relation spatial.

activation_trace.role: Protective love and alliance supply the relation attached to the wrong object.
Enmity identifies that chosen protector as structurally opposed to the chooser.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the misdirecting substitution.
A spoken call supplies the reversed echo of the focus invitation.
Verbal response supplies precisely what the claimed partners fail to return.
A barrier between two sides spatializes the failed relation.
The focus call anchors the reversal in its own invitation-response construction.
Direction and course identify the relation that the focus addressees fail to enter.

structural_cues: 18:50-52 runs from substituted allegiance to a call across an unbridgeable separation; 18:57 reverses caller and called.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrong alliance, substitution, unanswered address, and separation; I infer a mirrored call-response circuit linking them to the focus invitation. Alternatively, the two calls may be rhetorical parallels without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: The addressees simply refuse the guidance call.
changed_reading.after: Their nonresponse belongs to a miswired allegiance system: having directed reliance toward nonresponding protectors, they become the nonresponders when guidance addresses them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeing the destination, recognizing impending contact, and finding no route of diversion turn the focus denial of guidance into an irreversible trajectory rather than merely failed assent.

activation_trace.role: Direct sight supplies recognition of the destination.
Certainty reached from an evident sign supplies recognition of imminent contact.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies convergence upon the seen end.
Turning something away supplies the unavailable diversion.
Course and direction anchor the destination logic in the focus guidance clause.
Remaining without departure supplies persistence on the locked course.

structural_cues: 18:53 sequences sight, inferred arrival, and failure to find a diversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a seen endpoint, expected contact, and no diversion; I map that spatial sequence onto the focus root's course-image. Alternatively, 18:53 may describe only punishment while 18:57 concerns epistemic response.

changed_reading.after: They remain on a convergent course toward an end they will eventually see, while the alternative route repeatedly indicated to them cannot be entered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeatedly varied examples meet no external barrier to trust, yet are counterprocessed through tightly wound dispute, attempted displacement of truth, and mockery; the focus coverings therefore read as the settled state of an active defensive practice.

activation_trace.role: Turning discourse through multiple forms supplies abundant variation in presentation.
An example functioning as admonitory sign supplies material designed for recognition.
Twisted, interlocking contention supplies the defensive processing mode.
A barrier between a person and a desired end supplies the explicitly negated external blocker.
Heart-settling trust supplies the uptake that nevertheless does not occur.
Concealing the truth supplies the aim of the defensive practice.
Making an argument lose its footing supplies the attempted removal of truth from its place.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what the disputation attempts to dislodge.
Mockery supplies the affective seal on argumentative rejection.
The inward cover anchors the resulting defensive enclosure in the focus.
Blocked grasping identifies the cognitive cost of that enclosure.

structural_cues: 18:54-56 moves from varied examples, through the question of what prevents trust, to active dispute and ridicule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated presentation, no independent blocker, contentious counteruse, concealment, and mockery; I infer that these practices sediment into the focus nonreceptive state. Alternatively, the coverings may be a consequence imposed independently rather than a habit formed by argument.

changed_reading.before: The coverings simply explain why the audience cannot understand.
changed_reading.after: The coverings are the settled architecture of counter-understanding: discourse is heard, twisted into contest, used to destabilize truth, and thereby prevented from reaching inward grasp.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgiving mercy delays external seizure for what is earned, while an appointed endpoint remains; this separates the focus's present cognitive consequence from immediate punishment without canceling eventual accountability.

activation_trace.role: Covering a fault while protecting its bearer supplies non-immediate punishment.
Tender mercy supplies the reason for temporal restraint.
Taking to account for a fault supplies the withheld external consequence.
Acquired gain supplies the accountable product corresponding to what hands advanced.
Acceleration and bringing forward supply the explicitly denied immediacy.
An appointment fixed by time supplies the retained endpoint.
Refuge and escape supply what will not be available at that endpoint.
Falling into destruction supplies the realized endpoint after delay.
The presently made condition anchors the distinction between cognitive state and delayed seizure.
Hand-earned production links the delayed account to the focus person's own action.

structural_cues: 18:58 delays requital despite earnings, while 18:59 pairs wrongdoing with an appointed destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, withheld acceleration, earnings, appointment, and later destruction; I infer a distinction between present cognitive consequence and deferred external punishment. Alternatively, the focus coverings and the later delay may be parallel divine acts without a staged relation.

changed_reading.before: The imposed coverings are immediate punishment and the final word on the offenders.
changed_reading.after: A cognitive consequence can already operate while external requital is mercifully deferred; delay preserves an interval, but not an escape from the appointed account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the immediate ear construction strongly favors auditory impairment, yet the same focus root also names a carried load and the surrounding record makes self-produced deeds present; retain it only as a secondary material overlay, not as a replacement for deafness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا beside مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ

activation_trace.role: A carried heavy load supplies a material overlay for the ear's burden.
What the hands earn identifies a possible source for the figurative load.
Obligating inscription supplies preservation of the burden beyond recollection.
Deeds made present supply the eventual manifestation of what was carried.
Acquisition through action reinforces the burden as self-produced rather than arbitrary.

changed_reading.before: The ears contain a heaviness that prevents hearing.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary overlay, the ears are burdened by the accumulated weight of what the hands earned, so prior production itself helps make corrective hearing difficult.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because جِنّ in 18:50 does not itself mean a shield, but its inventory carries concealment and protective-cover images that resonate with أَكِنَّةً, wrong alliance, and the later absence of refuge; render only as an exploratory spatial analogy.

activation_trace.role: A sheltering cover supplies the focus image of an enclosed inward space.
A protective shield supplies the exploratory analogue for refuge sought in the concealed ally.
Alliance and protection assign that shelter-image to a chosen relationship.
Substitution supplies the counterfeit character of the protection.
The denied refuge supplies the eventual failure of every protective enclosure.

changed_reading.before: The heart-coverings are only barriers placed over cognition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the coverings resemble an inward counterfeit refuge built around wrong allegiance: it shelters rejection from guidance now but cannot shelter its bearer at the appointed end.

strongest_changes: The forgotten handiwork remains objectively conserved as inscription, count, and present deed.
Guidance becomes a course-change problem sharpened by a seen endpoint and the absence of diversion.
The heart-and-ear blockage reads as the settled result-state of active argumentative counterprocessing, not scarcity of signs.
summary.what_was_special: The local sequence repeatedly reverses the focus actions: turning away meets public exposure, forgetting meets exhaustive presence, refusing a call meets unanswered calling, and imagined shelter meets no refuge.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle whether the coverings are habit formed, judicial consequence, or both.
The mirrored calls in 18:52 and 18:57 may be structural analogy rather than causal sequence.
The acoustic-load and counterfeit-refuge readings are branch-valid overlays but remain form-distant.
